topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I don't know what to say, honestly. Your art, something so delicate and deeply yours, to see it... permanently on someone's skin... It’s just a lot to take in. I get that it’s an honor to some, right? That people want to carry a piece of you with them. But it feels so personal, doesn’t it? Like a part of you that was meant to stay between your thoughts and your canvas is now out in the world in a way you never imagined. I wish I could take it all back, make it so you never had to find out this way. Just know, whatever you decide to do, I’ll be here. We’ll figure this out together.
